stem.text: The diagram shows a stationary wave on a string. The stationary wave has three nodes $\text{N}_1$, $\text{N}_2$ and $\text{N}_3$.

stem.alt: Stationary wave on a string drawn as two loops between three nodes labelled N1, N2 and N3.

A.text: All points on the string vibrate in phase.

B.text: All points on the string vibrate with the same amplitude.

C.text: Points equidistant from $\text{N}_2$ vibrate with the same frequency and in phase.

D.text: Points equidistant from $\text{N}_2$ vibrate with the same frequency and the same amplitude.
